Access.name: pdfDescrAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select distinct A.CODE as pdfCode , A.DESCR as pdfDescr from PDF_ANAG A, PDF_PUBLICATION P where A.PDF_ID = P.PDF_ID and (A.START_DATE is null or A.START_DATE <= getDate()) and (A.END_DATE is null or dateadd(dd,+1,A.END_DATE) >= getDate()) and P.PUBLICATION_ID = (select P2.PUBLICATION_ID from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = A.PDF_ID and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) and ( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(A.DESCR),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%pdfDescrForLike%) or str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(A.CODE),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%pdfDescrForLike%) )
and A.AREA in (areas) order by 1

Access.name: pdfList
Access.Query:
select distinct A.PDF_ID as pdfId , A.CODE as pdfCode , A.DESCR as pdfDescr , A.IS_STAMPA_ENABLED , A.IS_CARTA_LIBERA_ENABLED , A.IS_CARTA_CHIMICA_ENABLED , A.IS_FIRMA_DIGTALE_ENABLED , A.IS_COPERNICO_ENABLED , (select P2.PUBLICATION_ID from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = A.PDF_ID and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) , (select P2.EDITION from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = A.PDF_ID and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) from PDF_ANAG A, PDF_PUBLICATION P where A.PDF_ID = P.PDF_ID and (A.START_DATE is null or A.START_DATE <= getDate()) and (A.END_DATE is null or dateadd(dd,+1,A.END_DATE) >= getDate()) and P.PUBLICATION_ID = (select P2.PUBLICATION_ID from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where (P2.IS_ARCHIVED is null or P2.IS_ARCHIVED = 'N') and P2.PDF_ID = A.PDF_ID and P2.START_DATE <= getdate() having P2.START_DATE = max(P2.START_DATE) and P2.PUBLISH_TIME = max(P2.PUBLISH_TIME)) and ( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(A.DESCR),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%pdfDescrForLike%) or str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace( str_replace(upper(A.CODE),'[','%') ,']','%') ,'-','%') ,'_','%') ,'/','%') ,'(','%') ,')','%') ,'.','%') ,' ','%') like upper(
%pdfDescrForLike%) )
and A.AREA in (areas) order by 3

Access.name: pdfDraftList
Access.Query:
select I.PDF_INSTANCE_ID , I.PDF_ID , I.CODE , I.PUBLICATION_ID , (select P2.EDITION from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where P2.PDF_ID = I.PDF_ID and P2.PUBLICATION_ID = I.PUBLICATION_ID) , I.DESCR , I.CREATION_USER , I.CREATION_TIME , I.STATO , isnull((select M.X_MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE from PDF_MODALITA_SOTTOSCRIZIONE M where M.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE = I.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE),isnull(MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE,'non spec.'))
, I.COD_AGENTE , (select sogg.DENOMINAZIONE from PARC..ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO sogg WHERE right('0000000000' + sogg.COD_SOGGETTO, 10) = I.COD_AGENTE)null
, I.CLI1_NDG , I.CLI1_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI1_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI1_COGNOME , I.CLI1_NOME
, I.CLI2_NDG , I.CLI2_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI2_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI2_COGNOME , I.CLI2_NOME
, I.CLI3_NDG , I.CLI3_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI3_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI3_COGNOME , I.CLI3_NOME
, I.CLI4_NDG , I.CLI4_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI4_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI4_COGNOME , I.CLI4_NOME
, I.CLI5_NDG , I.CLI5_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI5_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI5_COGNOME , I.CLI5_NOME
, I.CLI6_NDG , I.CLI6_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI6_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI6_COGNOME , I.CLI6_NOME
, I.CLI7_NDG , I.CLI7_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI7_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI7_COGNOME , I.CLI7_NOME
, I.CLI8_NDG , I.CLI8_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI8_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI8_COGNOME , I.CLI8_NOME
, I.CLI9_NDG , I.CLI9_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI9_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI9_COGNOME , I.CLI9_NOME
from PDF_INSTANCE I where I.STATO = '01' and (I.CREATION_USER =
contextUserCode or (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextUserCode and I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB')) (I.CREATION_USER =
contextUserCode) (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and (I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB' or I.CREATION_USERTYPE='RETE')) (1 = 2) and I.ENVIRONMENT in (pdfEnvironment) and I.CLI1_NDG = (select right('00000000000' +
cli1_ndg, 11)) order by I.CREATION_TIME desc

Access.name: pdfCompletedList
Access.Query:
select I.PDF_INSTANCE_ID , I.PDF_ID , I.CODE , I.PUBLICATION_ID , (select P2.EDITION from PDF_PUBLICATION P2 where P2.PDF_ID = I.PDF_ID and P2.PUBLICATION_ID = I.PUBLICATION_ID) , I.DESCR , I.COMPLETION_USER , I.COMPLETION_TIME , I.STATO , I.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE , isnull((select M.X_MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE from PDF_MODALITA_SOTTOSCRIZIONE M where M.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE = I.MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE),MODALITA_DI_SOTTOSCRIZIONE) as pdfCompilationModeDescr
, I.COD_AGENTE , (select sogg.DENOMINAZIONE from PARC..ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO sogg WHERE right('0000000000' + sogg.COD_SOGGETTO, 10) = I.COD_AGENTE)sogg.DENOMINAZIONEnull
, I.CLI1_NDG , I.CLI1_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI1_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI1_COGNOME , I.CLI1_NOME
, I.CLI2_NDG , I.CLI2_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI2_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI2_COGNOME , I.CLI2_NOME
, I.CLI3_NDG , I.CLI3_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI3_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI3_COGNOME , I.CLI3_NOME
, I.CLI4_NDG , I.CLI4_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI4_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI4_COGNOME , I.CLI4_NOME
, I.CLI5_NDG , I.CLI5_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI5_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI5_COGNOME , I.CLI5_NOME
, I.CLI6_NDG , I.CLI6_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI6_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI6_COGNOME , I.CLI6_NOME
, I.CLI7_NDG , I.CLI7_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI7_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI7_COGNOME , I.CLI7_NOME
, I.CLI8_NDG , I.CLI8_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI8_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI8_COGNOME , I.CLI8_NOME
, I.CLI9_NDG , I.CLI9_ID_CENSIMENTO , I.CLI9_ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE , I.CLI9_COGNOME , I.CLI9_NOME
from PDF_INSTANCE I , PARC..ARC_ANAG_SOGGETTO sogg where I.STATO = '03' and (I.COMPLETION_USER =
contextUserCode or (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextUserCode and I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB')) (1 = 1) (I.COD_AGENTE =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and (I.CREATION_USERTYPE='ASSISTENTEFB' or I.CREATION_USERTYPE='RETE')) (1 = 2)
and I.COD_AGENTE = right('0000000000' +
codAgente, 10)
and I.COD_AGENTE = right('0000000000' + sogg.COD_SOGGETTO, 10) and upper(sogg.DENOMINAZIONE) like upper(
%nominativoAgente%)
and (upper(I.CLI1_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI2_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI3_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI4_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI5_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI6_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI7_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI8_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%) or upper(I.CLI9_COGNOME) like upper(
cli1_cognome%))
and (upper(I.CLI1_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI2_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI3_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI4_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI5_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI6_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI7_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI8_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%) or upper(I.CLI9_NOME) like upper(
cli1_nome%))
and (upper(I.DESCR) like upper(
%pdfAnag_pdfDescr%) or upper(I.CODE) like upper(
%pdfAnag_pdfDescr%))
and I.COMPLETION_TIME >= convert(varchar(8),
dataInizio,112) and I.COMPLETION_TIME < convert(varchar(8),dateadd(dd,+1,
dataFine),112) and I.ENVIRONMENT in (pdfEnvironment) and I.CLI1_NDG = (select right('00000000000' +
cli1_ndg, 11)) order by I.COMPLETION_TIME desc
